text: “Why have we come to the Tyrol, if it comes to that? One might go on asking such questions indefinitely.” One might; but he was only gaining time for a plausible answer. Out it came, and he believed it as soon as it was spoken. “The truth is, I took Oniton on account of Evie. Don’t let this go any further.” “Certainly not.” “I shouldn’t like her to know that she nearly let me in for a very bad bargain.
